pageTitle: OpenNava × Luna Browser · From the web to your TV
description: Explore Luna Browser and OpenNava. Save a programme and open it later on your TV.
ogDesc: Discover on the web. Watch on TV. An interactive browser and TV demo.
intro: Save a programme in Luna Browser and open it later on your TV with OpenNava.
playClip: Play the sample clip Above the Clouds
sharedHelp: Choose a programme in Luna and open it on the demo TV.
tvHelp: Open the Luna watchlist in full mode and choose a programme. Press OK on your remote to confirm each step.
directions: Click, tap or use the arrow keys. Enter selects an item. Esc goes back.
noJS: The interactive demo needs JavaScript. Find the guides and downloads below.
lunaDesc: A desktop browser with colour themes, mouse gestures and a personal home page. The preview sends links to your paired TV over your home network. If the TV is off, Luna retries while the browser is running.
navaDesc: Your home screen for Android TV and Fire TV with Fire OS. Use your remote to open apps, live TV and media libraries, or choose the larger buttons in senior mode.
setupHelp: Choose a view for your TV, then copy the setup instructions for your AI agent.
downloadsHelp: The downloads link to the stable releases. Sending titles from Luna is a preview feature you can try above.
aDevices: OpenNava runs on Android TV, Google TV and Fire TV with Android-based Fire OS. During setup from your computer, approve the debugging request on your TV.
qCompanion: What does the companion app do?
aCompanion: The optional Android companion lets you browse the guide on your phone and open a programme on your paired TV. Both TV views also work with your remote.
aUpdates: OpenNava checks the GitHub project for signed releases. Install an update with your paired Android companion or setup agent. Your TV may ask you to confirm installation.
qNetflix: How does OpenNava open a Netflix title?
aNetflix: The installed Netflix app handles saved Netflix links. Depending on the device, it opens the title or its home screen. The website demo opens the official Netflix title page.
alpineDesc: A journey through the quiet lakes and peaks of the Alps.
oceanDesc: An evening on the Atlantic coast, just before sunset.
netflixDesc: Open the official Netflix title page from your watchlist.
setupInstructions: Help me set up OpenNava on my TV. Selected profile: {profile}. Follow this guide: {guide}. Use the setup tool with --profile {id}. Help me connect the TV and, if requested, set up the Android companion app.
copySuccess: You can now paste the instructions into your AI agent.
copyManual: Use your browser to copy the selected text.
netflixNote: On a TV the installed Netflix app opens the title or its home screen, depending on the device.
tvSettingsHelp: Choose the three home shortcuts, search preferences and appearance of your paired demo TV.
noServices: Choose a media library or another service to search.
openProvider: On your TV this opens the installed app.
